items.title: More Examples of Common Ion Effect (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: More Examples of Common Ion Effect: a main subheading of 9.6 Common ion effect, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 198-199.

blocks.text: i. Less soluble (kam ghulne wala) salt KClO₃ pani mein hai. Us mein more soluble (zyada ghulne wala) salt KCl dalein to common ion K⁺ ki wajah se KClO₃ ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) kam ho jati hai; us ki ionization dab jati hai aur woh precipitate ban kar beth jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein KClO₃ se “ClO⁻” bante dikhaya gaya hai; KClO₃ se chlorate ion ClO₃⁻ banta hai.

ii. Isi tarah weak acid H₂S ka dissociation strong acid HCl dal kar dabaya ja sakta hai. Yahan H⁺ common ion hai. Acidic solution mein H₂S kam dissociate hota hai, is liye S²⁻ ion ki concentration kam rehti hai.
S²⁻ ki yeh kam concentration salt analysis mein second group ke basic radicals ko precipitate karne mein madad karti hai.

iii. NH₃ solution mein NH₄Cl dalne se NH₄Cl se aane wale bohat zyada NH₄⁺ ki wajah se OH⁻ ki concentration dab jati hai. NH₄Cl strong electrolyte hai. In dono ka mixture salt analysis mein third group ke basic radicals ka group reagent hai.
Common ion effect qualitative analysis aur buffers banane mein bohat istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Equilibrium mein jis ion ki amount bahar se barha di jaye, reaction us ion ko kam karne ki taraf (ulti taraf) chalti hai. Is liye kam ghulne wala salt ya weak acid aur kam ionize hota hai.

items: Common ion weak ya kam ghulne wale electrolyte ki ionization dabata hai.
Brine mein HCl gas → NaCl crystallize; KCl → KClO₃ precipitate; HCl → H₂S kam dissociate (group II ke liye kam S²⁻); NH₄Cl → NH₃ mein OH⁻ kam (group III reagent).
